requirements.title: Event filtering by time and domain
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/events supports query params: start_time, end_time, domains (comma-separated), event_types (comma-separated), limit, offset. Returns paginated event list.

requirements.title: Event aggregation queries
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/events/aggregate supports grouping by day/week/month, aggregation functions (count, avg, sum), and domain filtering. Returns time-bucketed aggregates.

requirements.title: Cross-domain correlation queries
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/correlations accepts two event types and returns statistical correlation with confidence interval. Example: 'show me sleep quality on days I took magnesium vs days I didn't'.
